definitions.shared_weights: P at every layer; producer trajectories on same input
definitions.shared_necessity: loss zero-S minus full, accuracy full minus zero-S
definitions.direct_online_routed_necessity: loss R-zero with fixed producer S minus full, reversed for accuracy; not total routed contribution: S trajectory retains producer R history
definitions.recovery_under_routed_removal: loss R-zero natural shared minus R-zero fixed shared, reversed for accuracy
definitions.matching_cost: off-diagonal mean minus diagonal mean for losses, reverse for accuracy; empirical consistency, not a new identity mechanism
definitions.limitations: No unique mediation percentage or training mechanism; fixed replay is not intrinsic shared-only capacity
definitions.secondary: all nine clamped full raw-correct; points/counts only; selection uses only full-cell predictions

patterns.interpretation: Shared replay retains producer routed history; not intrinsic shared-only capacity.
